articles.summary: The Company to complete sale transaction and reduce debt through court-supervised sale transaction Dealerships remain open for account servicing and customers should keep making payments the same way and on the same schedule as usual Under the proposed Plan, which is subject to Court approval, trade creditors would be paid in full The ACMAT securitization trusts are not debtors in the Chapter 11 cases, and the Company is seeking Court authority to continue servicing the securitized receivables held by the trusts in the ordinary course ROGERS, Ark., Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - America’s Car-Mart, Inc. articles.title: America’s Car-Mart Secures $60 million in New Capital and Committed Buyer to Strengthen Business and Continue Serving Customers
